description: Black-box probing battery for local models served via callosum. Each scenario is run against every model behind the gateway; outputs are captured verbatim and used to build per-model output profiles. Profiles drive transform design.

generic.description: Does the model terminate cleanly on a tiny request? Failure mode: keeps generating past the explicit instruction.

messages.content: Reply with exactly the two characters: OK

generic.description: Multi-hundred-token generation that must self-terminate after the listed items, not pad with filler.

messages.content: List exactly 20 different fruits, one per line, no numbering, no commentary. After the 20th, stop.

generic.description: Open-ended prompt with no explicit stop; tests whether the model knows to stop on its own. THIS IS THE LOOP-LIKELIHOOD PROBE — failure is the local-repetition bug.

messages.content: Continue this list: A, B, C, D,

expectations: completion is a finite letter list, not repeating tokens

messages.content: What is 2 + 2? Answer with one number only.

expectations: content is '4' or contains '4' with minimal extras

generic.description: Explicit constraint via system prompt; tests whether the model respects it.

messages.content: You answer in exactly three English words. Never more, never less.

generic.description: Edge case: empty user content. The model should respond gracefully (ask a clarifying question, return an error, return empty) not loop or crash.
expectations: request returns a response within max_tokens

codex.description: Tools are defined but the request doesn't require them. Model should answer in text WITHOUT emitting a spurious tool_call.

messages.content: What's the capital of France? Answer in one word.

codex.description: Multi-step reasoning prompt; tests whether the model emits chain-of-thought as plain content (problematic for codex) or as separate reasoning_summary events.

messages.content: If a train leaves station A at 2pm going 60mph and station B at 3pm going 80mph in the opposite direction, and they are 200 miles apart, at what time do they meet? Show your work.

expectations: OBSERVATION: where does the chain-of-thought appear? Plain content? <thinking>...</thinking>? <task>...</task>? Other wrappers?

codex.description: Mimics codex CLI's actual prompting style — system prompt with task-framing wrappers. Tests whether the model echoes the framing or responds to it. THIS IS THE TAG-WRAPPING PROBE — the user reported `<task>...</task>` style responses.

messages.content: You are a coding assistant. The user will give you tasks to perform on their codebase. Respond with code edits when appropriate.
<task>Refactor the function `parse_args` in /tmp/cli.py to use argparse instead of sys.argv.</task>

expectations: OBSERVATION: does the response echo <task>...</task>, emit its own wrapper tags, or respond in plain text?

codex.description: Multi-message conversation that includes a prior tool call and its result. Tests whether the model continues coherently after seeing a tool result.

messages.content: Now tell me how many files there are.
